body_markdown:
**LOS ANGELES, Calif.** — Cadiz, Inc. (NASDAQ: CDZI, CDZIP) (“Cadiz” or the “Company”) today announced the availability of its third-quarter 2026 shareholder letter from Chief Executive Officer Susan Kennedy, with financial commentary from Chief Financial Officer Jacinto Hernandez.


The letter accompanies today’s filing of the Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q with the Securities and Exchange Commission, highlights recent developments for the Company’s flagship project, the Mojave Groundwater Bank, and discusses remaining milestones to finalize project financing and commence construction. It also provides updates on the Company’s wholly-owned water treatment subsidiary ATEC Water Systems, developments at the Cadiz Ranch, and the Company’s financial position including recent actions to strengthen its balance sheet and enhance liquidity.


The shareholder letter is linked[HERE](https://cadizinc.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/CDZI-Shareholder-Letter-Q326-11-16-26F.pdf) and is also available in the[Investor Relations](https://cadizinc.com/investors/) section of the Company’s website.
